title: AC1021 ModelDocViewStyle physical selected output and readback
scope: Qualify an exact selected projection of the four physical AC1021 ModelDocViewStyle frames, both NOD-rooted style dictionaries, and their extension-dictionary/XRECORD graph in ASCII and Binary DXF with fresh typed readback and output rollback/retry controls.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing; author and producer are not independently authenticated. No drawing fixture or derivative is committed.

sourceGraph.namedObjectDictionary: Handle 0xC has one ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE edge to dictionary 0x21B and one ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE edge to dictionary 0x219.
sourceGraph.detailDictionary: Dictionary 0x21B is owned by and reacts to NOD 0xC. Ordered entries Imperial24 -> DETAILVIEWSTYLE 0x18082 and Metric50 -> DETAILVIEWSTYLE 0x21C.
sourceGraph.sectionDictionary: Dictionary 0x219 is owned by and reacts to NOD 0xC. Ordered entries Imperial24 -> SECTIONVIEWSTYLE 0x18081 and Metric50 -> SECTIONVIEWSTYLE 0x21A.
sourceGraph.recordFrames: The four raw source frames match ACDBSECTIONVIEWSTYLE type 515 / AcDbSectionViewStyle and ACDBDETAILVIEWSTYLE type 516 / AcDbDetailViewStyle, with common owner equal to their dictionary. Typed callbacks match each handle, name, owner and record family.
sourceGraph.resourceReferences: All four typed styles resolve text-style handle 0x11 and linetype handle 0x16 through the source table inventory. Arrow/block references are zero in this sample.
sourceGraph.extensionRecords: All four styles reference one extension dictionary; each extension dictionary contains ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP targeting one XRECORD. The XRECORD owner/reactor and ordered payload are checked on output readback. Source XRECORD extensionDictionaryFlag=1 with xDictHandle=0 is preserved as the source model state but is not represented in DXF and is not compared as a DXF field.

Checks typed field and reference readback, valid absent extension dictionaries (NoHandle with flag 0), extension dictionary dependency refusal, wrong dictionary owner atomic refusal, and cross-version refusal.

Expected injected-failure diagnostics are emitted.

projection.records: Two rooted style dictionaries, four typed style records, four extension dictionaries, and four XRECORDs; required text-style and linetype targets are retained.

It is projected to DXF group-62 sentinel 257, consistent with this codebase’s existing TABLESTYLE serializer convention. ODA §2.11 documents CMC wire structure; this receipt does not claim independent ODA documentation of the method-to-sentinel semantics.
